x: The Conventical was the Inquisitors' fortress, and the steel inscription quoted in the epigraphs lay in its depths.

q: In The Bands of Mourning, what kind of vessel had Allik and his crewmates been travelling in?
x: The Brunstell, a southern airship, crashed in a storm and was captured by the Set.

q: In The Lost Metal, which member of Wax's family leads the Set?
x: Telsin is one of the Set's leaders and plots against Elendel, putting her at odds with her brother.

q: In The Lost Metal, what does the Set try to bring into Elendel by ship?
x: Wax and Wayne discover that the bomb is not at the Set's base but aboard a ship bound for the city.

q: In Shadows of Self, which leader has Bleeder secretly killed and been impersonating to stir up unrest in Elendel?
x: Bleeder wore the governor's face to turn the city's workers against their rulers, and also murdered his brother Winsting.

q: According to Brandon Sanderson, which kandra gave Wax his earring?
x: Sanderson revealed it at a 2011 book signing: MeLaan had handed it to Wax in person, years before he returned to Elendel.

q: At the end of The Bands of Mourning, who is given the Bands, as Steris proposes?
x: Steris's compromise keeps the Bands out of the hands of both Elendel and the southerners.

q: In The Bands of Mourning, by what title do the southern Scadrians remember the figure who came to them after the Ice Death?
x: According to the southerners, the Sovereign came to help them survive the cold after the Ice Death.

q: In The Lost Metal, Wax and Steris's daughter shares her name with which era 1 character?
x: Wax and Steris have two young children, Maxillium and Tindwyl.

q: In The Bands of Mourning, in which town do Marasi and MeLaan find Allik held captive at the Set's compound?
x: The Set held Allik and the wreck of his airship, the Brunstell, at its compound in Dulsing.

q: In Shadows of Self, what does Wax shoot Bleeder with so that Harmony can regain control of her?
o: A bullet forged from his earring
A bullet filled with liquid duralumin
x: The Hemalurgic metal let Harmony reach Bleeder's mind, but she chose to die rather than submit.

q: Who is Raoden's father?
x: Iadon, a former merchant, became King of Arelon after the Reod.

q: Which kingdom is Princess Sarene from?
x: Sarene, daughter of King Eventeo, comes to Arelon to marry Prince Raoden.

q: From which nation does the gyorn Hrathen come?
x: Hrathen is sent from Fjorden to convert Arelon before it is too late.

q: Which religion does Hrathen preach in Arelon?
x: Hrathen tries to turn the Arelenes away from Shu-Korath and towards Shu-Dereth.

q: Galladon, Raoden's first friend in Elantris, comes from which country?
x: Galladon is a Dula who was taken by the Shaod and thrown into Elantris.

q: What is the name of Sarene's seon?
x: Ashe is Sarene's loyal seon and one of her most trusted advisers.

q: What is the transformation that turns ordinary people into Elantrians called?
x: Before the Reod, the Shaod made people godlike; afterwards it left them cursed.

q: How many years before the novel did the Reod bring Elantris down?
x: Elantris has lain in ruin for a decade when Raoden is thrown into it.

q: What alias does Raoden use inside Elantris to hide his identity?
x: The name comes from Aon Rao, the Aon in Raoden's own name, which means spirit.

q: After the Reod, what happens to a cut an Elantrian receives?
x: Elantrians' hearts no longer beat, and every wound keeps hurting forever.

q: What is the magic of drawing Aons in the air called?
x: AonDor drew its power from the Dor and stopped working after the Reod.

q: Who is Sarene's uncle, whose family welcomes her in Arelon?
x: Kiin is the brother of Sarene's father, King Eventeo, and a superb cook.

q: What does Raoden give the Elantrians to help them endure their constant pain?
o: Extra food from the city outside
x: Raoden realizes that keeping busy helps the Elantrians bear their pain.

q: Which sport is Sarene highly skilled at?
x: Sarene is an expert fencer and even teaches the noblewomen of the court to fence.

q: Who becomes King of Arelon at the end of Elantris?
x: Restored as a true Elantrian, Raoden takes the throne with Sarene at his side.

q: How long does the Wyrn give Hrathen to convert Arelon before his empire destroys it?
x: Hrathen knows Arelon will be invaded if he fails within that deadline.

q: From which city does King Iadon rule Arelon after the Reod?
x: Kae is one of the four cities around Elantris; the others were abandoned after the Reod.

q: What effect does Aon Daa produce when drawn by an Elantrian?
x: Aon Daa means power or energy and was the Elantrians' preferred weapon.

q: What are Elantrians called who are overwhelmed by pain and can only moan?
x: Their wounds never heal, so pain accumulates until the Elantrian's mind gives way.

q: How does Hrathen stage a fake 'cure' after he is thrown into Elantris?
o: He drinks a potion that mimics the Shaod
x: He secretly drinks a potion that mimics the Shaod's symptoms, then takes its antidote and claims Jaddeth cured him.

q: What is the Derethi priest Dilaf secretly?
x: Dilaf's bones were reshaped in the Dakhor monastery, granting him dark powers.

q: Which country is the baron Shuden from?
x: Shuden is a skilled practitioner of the JinDo martial art ChayShan.

q: What event broke the magic of the Elantrians and caused the Reod?
x: The resulting chasm changed the land of Arelon, which the Aons are tied to, so every Aon needed a new line.

q: Who is the god worshipped by the followers of Shu-Dereth?
x: The Derethi believe Jaddeth will rise from beneath the earth once all people are united.

q: Why is Sarene considered Raoden's widow despite never meeting him?
x: The treaty stated that if either betrothed died, the marriage would count as binding.

q: What is the name of Raoden's seon, which goes mad after Raoden's transformation?
x: A seon whose master becomes an Elantrian after the Reod goes mad.

q: What does Aon Ien do when drawn by an Elantrian?
x: Healing with Aon Ien required modifiers specifying which part of the body to mend.

q: Which secret cult did King Iadon practise, sacrificing his own staff?
x: After Sarene exposed him, Iadon was arrested and took his own life in prison.

q: Which nobleman was Sarene about to marry when she was cast into Elantris?
x: On the wedding day she appeared to be taken by the Shaod (really another dose of Hrathen's potion), and Telrii took the throne.

q: From which older religion do both Shu-Dereth and Shu-Korath derive?
x: Shu-Keseg originated in JinDo and taught the unity of all mankind.

q: Before coming to Arelon, Hrathen had instigated a revolution in which country?
x: The bloodshed in Duladel haunted Hrathen and shaped his doubts about Wyrn's plans.

q: Which member of Sarene's uncle's family has been secretly hidden as an Elantrian?
x: His parents hid Adien's transformation so he would not be thrown into Elantris.

q: What kind of Selish magic does Shai practise?
x: Shai is considered one of the best Forgers in the Rose Empire.

q: Whose soul must Shai recreate in The Emperor's Soul?
x: Assassins left Emperor Ashravan alive but with his mind destroyed.

q: Which elderly arbiter slowly comes to respect Shai's art?
x: Unlike the other arbiters, Gaotona comes to see Shai's craft as a true art.

q: In The Emperor's Soul, how many days does Shai have to create the emperor's new soul?
x: The emperor's absence is hidden behind a hundred-day mourning period for his late wife.

q: What does a Forger change with a soulstamp?
x: A Forgery holds only if the rewritten past is plausible for the object.

q: What was Shai caught trying to steal?
x: A trusted accomplice betrayed her, swapping her copy back for the real scepter.

q: How long a mourning period do the arbiters have to hide the emperor's state?
x: If Ashravan did not reappear in time, his faction would lose power.

q: To which faction do Ashravan and his arbiters belong?
x: The faction depends on the emperor's survival to keep ruling the empire.

q: Which ambitious arbiter is the most powerful of the emperor's councillors?
x: Frava secretly intends to control the restored emperor and to be rid of Shai.

q: Who is the captain of the guard who threatens to kill Shai one day?
x: Zu is a Striker who personally escorts Shai to the arbiters.

q: What do Bloodsealers use as ink in their stamps?
x: With it, a Bloodsealer can animate skeletons to hunt down a target.

q: What does an Essence Mark rewrite?
x: Shai uses Essence Marks to briefly gain skills she does not normally have.

q: Which major award did The Emperor's Soul win in 2013?
x: It won the Hugo for Best Novella.

q: Which rival faction is blamed for the attempt on Ashravan's life?
x: An emperor's death would favour the Glory Faction's bid for the succession.

q: Which people of the Rose Empire does Shai belong to?
x: Shai is a MaiPon, one of the peoples living within the Rose Empire.

q: Who is the protagonist of The Hope of Elantris?
x: Matisse protects the children of New Elantris on the night of the Dakhor attack.

q: Which Shard Splintered the two Shards whose power is trapped around Sel?
x: Odium struck them down long ago, and their scattered power now fuels the Dor.

q: What is the Dor, the power behind Selish magic?
o: The trapped power of two Shards
x: The Investiture of two Splintered Shards is trapped in Sel's Cognitive Realm, where it forms the Dor.

q: How does Hrathen secretly communicate with the Wyrn from Arelon?
x: Like every gyorn, Hrathen was secretly given a seon by the Wyrn, even though seons are Elantrian creations.

q: Who kills the Derethi priest Dilaf in the climax of Elantris?
x: Hrathen kills Dilaf to save Sarene before succumbing to his own wounds.

q: Where inside Elantris does Aanden's gang make its home?
x: Aanden set up his court in the university because Karata's gang held the palace.

q: Who dies protecting Raoden while he adds the Chasm Line to Elantris?
x: Karata is beheaded fighting the Fjordell soldiers who try to stop Raoden, moments before Elantris is restored.

q: What did Raoden have to add to the Aons to make Elantris's magic work again?
o: A dot at the center of each Aon
x: The Reod changed the very land the Aons mirror, so every Aon needed a new line for it.

q: Once Shai's soulstamp restores the emperor, how often must it be applied?
x: The Forged soul does not take permanently, so the emperor must be restamped each day.

q: Who betrayed Shai during the theft that got her arrested?
x: The Imperial Fool swapped her copy back for the original and gave Shai up to the palace guards.

q: What is the name of the kindly Korathi priest in Kae who advises Sarene?
x: Father Omin, the absent-minded Korathi priest of Kae, explains the Widow's Trial to Sarene and officiates her weddings.

q: From which country does Jalla, the wife of Lukel, come?
x: Jalla is Svordish; she met Lukel while they were both studying at the Svordish university.

q: From which region of the Rose Empire does the art of Bloodsealing come?
x: Bloodsealing is a Dzhamarian art, and the Strikers find it repugnant.

q: In the Derethi hierarchy, which rank sits directly below gyorn?
x: A ragnat usually oversees a whole region of Derethi worshippers.

q: What is the lowest rank of Derethi priest?
x: Dorven are the lowest Derethi priests and officially serve the gradors.

q: How many gyorns are there in the Fjordell Empire?
x: There are only twenty gyorns, and in nations that follow Shu-Dereth even kings bow to them.

q: Which Derethi monastery is known for training assassins?
x: Rathbore trains assassins, Fjeldor trains spies and Dakhor trains its bone-twisted warriors.

q: What physical trace did Hrathen keep from his early training as a monk?
o: A nearly indestructible bone in his forearm
An Aon carved into his chest
A soulstamp mark on his neck
x: He left that monastery for another, but one altered forearm bone remained, giving him great strength.

q: Which country does Forton, the potion-maker who supplies Hrathen, come from?
x: Forton is a Hrovell apothecary whose potions, including the one that mimics the Shaod, Hrathen relies on.

q: Aanden calls himself a baron, but what was he before the Shaod?
x: Aanden was really a sculptor named Taan, and he returns to sculpting after joining New Elantris.

q: In The Hope of Elantris, roughly how many children live together in the children's home of New Elantris?
x: Matisse helps look after the fifty or so children who live there.

q: In The Hope of Elantris, who is the adoptive father of the story's young heroine?
x: Dashe, Karata's second in command, brought her to Karata's palace after the Shaod took her.

q: In The Hope of Elantris, which Aon is drawn to lure and blind the pursuing soldiers?
x: Aon Ashe creates light, which the young heroine uses first as a lure and then to dazzle the soldiers.

q: Which Aon did Elantrians use to travel instantly from place to place?
x: Aon Tia is the Aon of travel, used for instant transportation before the Reod.

q: Which Aon serves as the symbol of Shu-Korath?
x: Aon Omi, which means love, is the emblem of Shu-Korath and is carved on its chapels.

q: The chapel inside Elantris that becomes the heart of New Elantris originally belonged to which religion?
x: The Elantrians built a Korathi chapel inside their city as a gesture of friendship toward Teod.

q: How many factions make up the government of the Rose Empire?
x: Each of the eighty factions, such as Heritage and Glory, is led by five arbiters.

q: The Strikers descend from which people, absorbed long ago by the Rose Empire?
x: The Grands renamed the Mulla'dil 'Strikers' after annexing their mountainous homeland.

q: In the forged past that Shai's Essence Mark Shaizan gives her, which warrior people trained her in martial arts?
x: The Shaizan Mark rewrites Shai's past so that she spent years training with the Teullu, masters of the martial arts.

q: What does Frava offer Shai in an attempt to bribe her?
x: On Day Seventeen, Frava tries to win Shai over with control of the city's smuggling operations.

q: How many Essence Marks had Shai created for herself?
x: Shai's Essence Marks took years of work to create; each rewrites her past to give her different skills, such as Shaizan's fighting ability.

q: Forgers prefer soulstone for their stamps. How is it hardened after carving?
x: Soulstone is soft and easy to carve in its natural state, then hardened by heating it.

q: How many moons orbit Sel?
x: Sel has a single blue-white moon, Oem.

q: Who is sent to Hallandren to marry the God King?
x: Siri, the youngest princess, is sent in place of her older sister.

q: From which kingdom do Siri and Vivenna come?
x: Idris is a small, austere highland kingdom north of Hallandren.

q: What is the capital city of Hallandren?
x: T'Telir is a colorful coastal city that houses the Court of Gods.

q: Lightsong is worshipped in Hallandren as the god of what?
x: Ironically, Lightsong doubts his own divinity and prefers jokes to heroics.

q: What is the purpose Nightblood was Awakened to fulfil?
x: Nightblood has no clear idea of what evil actually is, which makes it terribly dangerous.

q: Why is the God King Susebron unable to speak?
o: He took a vow of silence
x: His priests removed his tongue so he could never use his vast store of Breath to Awaken.

q: Who serves as Lightsong's high priest?
x: Lightsong nicknames the patient Llarimar "Scoot".

q: Who is the father of Siri and Vivenna?
x: Dedelin is bound by an old treaty that forces him to send a daughter to the God King.

q: Which mercenary leader works for Vivenna in T'Telir?
x: Denth seems a friendly hireling, but he is secretly working to start the war.

q: Besides Breath, what does Awakening draw from nearby objects?
x: Objects used as a source of color turn grey once the Awakening is done.

q: In Hallandren, what is a person called who has no Breath at all?
x: Drabs see colors as duller and are often shunned by others.

q: What are the Lifeless that make up Hallandren's armies?
x: Lifeless can be created with a single Breath and follow simple Commands.

q: What can members of Siri's royal family do with their hair?
x: The Royal Locks shift color with emotion, which Siri struggles to control.

q: What do the Returned usually lose when they come back from death?
x: Returned keep only vague dreams and impressions of who they were.

q: Which princess had been betrothed to the God King since birth?
x: Vivenna trained her whole life for the marriage, only to see her younger sister sent instead.

q: What is the name of the god worshipped in Idris?
x: Austrism teaches humility and frowns on bright colors and ostentation.

q: Blushweaver is the Hallandren goddess of what?
x: Blushweaver uses her political cunning to push the Court of Gods toward war with Idris.

q: To which people does the palace scribe Bluefingers belong?
x: Bluefingers plots a war between Hallandren and Idris to free the Pahn Kahl.

q: How often must a Returned absorb a new Breath to stay alive?
x: Hallandren citizens donate these Breaths, which keep the gods' Divine Breath going.

q: How many Heightenings of Breath are there?
x: The Tenth Heightening requires around 50,000 Breaths, a level held by the God King.

q: How does Lightsong save Susebron at the climax of Warbreaker?
x: The gift heals Susebron's tongue but costs Lightsong his life.

q: Which legendary figure who ended the Manywar is revealed to be Vasher?
x: Peacegiver ended the war by giving his treasure of Breath to the line of God Kings.

q: Where are Kalad's Phantoms secretly hidden in T'Telir?
x: The Phantoms are Lifeless made of bones encased in stone, posing as statues.

q: Which of Vasher's old companions hates him for killing his sister?
x: Vasher killed Denth's sister, and Denth has hated him for it ever since.

q: What color is the God King's palace in T'Telir's Court of Gods?
x: Susebron lives almost alone in the black palace of the God Kings, kept apart from his people.

q: Under what name does Vivenna appear in Kholinar in Oathbringer?
x: Vivenna travelled to Roshar and, in Kholinar, became known as the swordswoman Azure.

q: Which Awakener created Nightblood together with Vasher?
x: The two Awakened the sword together; Vasher later killed Shashara with it to keep the method of Awakening steel secret.

q: In the prologue, from which imprisoned rebel does Vasher obtain Breath?
x: Vahr had led a rebellion against Hallandren and hoarded Breath before his capture.

q: What are the Tears of Edgli, a major source of Hallandren's wealth?
x: Their vibrant dyes fuel the color trade that makes Hallandren rich.

q: Which dying Idrian spy passes his large store of Breath to Vivenna?
x: Lemex had been secretly poisoned, and the sudden Breath leaves Vivenna overwhelmed.

q: Who is the high priest of the God King Susebron?
x: Treledees dies defending the God King and his queen during the Pahn Kahl rebellion.

q: How do the God King and his young bride first manage to talk to each other?
x: Their secret written conversations happen at night in the God King's bedchamber.

q: As one of the Five Scholars, Vasher was known by what name?
x: Talaxin was his name in the days when the Five Scholars studied Awakening together.

q: Before he became the Lifeless called Clod, which of the Five Scholars was he?
x: Arsteel was killed by Vasher in a duel and later turned into a Lifeless.

q: Which of the Five Scholars discovered ichor-alcohol for Lifeless?
x: Ichor-alcohol replaces a Lifeless's blood and makes it far more durable.

q: Mercystar, whose palace is broken into, is the goddess of what?
x: Blushweaver uses the break-in to persuade Mercystar to join her preparations for war.

q: Who is the Vessel of the Shard Endowment?
x: Her name lives on in the Tears of Edgli, the flowers behind Hallandren's dyes.

q: Which Heightening makes an Awakener stop aging?
x: It takes about 2,000 Breaths, and every Returned enjoys its benefits automatically.

q: How did the man who became Lightsong die?
x: In life he was Stennimar, and his own brother later became his high priest.

q: What is the capital city of Idris?
x: Bevalis is a small city in a mountain valley, modest beside Hallandren's capital.

q: Besides Vasher, which Returned was secretly one of the Five Scholars?
x: For centuries, Denth hid that he was a Returned and one of the Five Scholars.

q: What color do Siri's Royal Locks turn when she is frightened?
x: Red shows anger or embarrassment, and black is the calm, controlled color Idrian royals are trained to keep.

q: Lightsong holds the Command phrases for how many of Hallandren's Lifeless?
x: Each of four gods holds the phrases for a quarter of the Lifeless army.

q: Which Command lets an Awakener take back the Breath stored in an object they Awakened?
x: The Awakener must touch the object; "My life to yours, my Breath become yours" is the Command that gives Breath away.

q: Why is the palace scribe Bluefingers given that nickname?
o: His fingers are stained with ink
He handles the palace's blue dyes
He lost his fingers to frostbite
x: His fingers seem permanently stained with blue ink, and he is rarely seen without his ledger.

q: Which colors do Lightsong, his priests and his servants wear?
x: Each Returned god of Hallandren has their own colors, worn by everyone in their service.

q: On what basis do the kings of Idris claim the right to rule Hallandren?
o: They are its royal line from before the Manywar
They hold Peacegiver's treasure of Breath
Austre crowned them after the Manywar
x: The royal family fled to the highlands when Hallandren chose to be ruled by the Returned.

q: Lightsong gives his Lifeless Command phrases to another Returned, who surprises him by handing over her own. Who?
x: With both sets of phrases, Lightsong suddenly controls half of Hallandren's Lifeless army.

q: Which Heightening grants perfect pitch?
x: It takes about 200 Breaths; the Third Heightening adds perfect color recognition.

q: At which Heightening can an Awakener use basic Commands instinctively, without any training?
x: The Sixth Heightening requires about 3,500 Breaths.

q: Roughly how many Breaths are needed to reach the First Heightening?
x: The First Heightening grants aura recognition and a stronger life sense.

q: How many Breaths went into Awakening Nightblood?
x: Awakening steel required forging the Breaths into the blade along with an extremely difficult visualization.

q: Lightsong keeps dreaming of a red panther. What was the Red Panther in his former life?
x: His brother borrowed the Red Panther for a family trip, and Lightsong later uses its name as a Command phrase.

q: Who was the first Returned, who proclaimed the Five Visions and died again a week later?
x: Hoid tells his story at the Court of Gods; the Five Visions became the core of Austrism.

q: According to Hoid's tale, who was chosen as the first monarch after Vo, beginning the line of the Idrian royals?
x: Vo's shipmates founded a kingdom and made his wife, who carried his child, their queen; her line later ruled Idris.

q: Hopefinder the Just is the Hallandren god of what?
x: Hopefinder is one of the four gods who hold the Command phrases of the Lifeless army.

q: Kalad the Usurper, whose name lives on in Kalad's Phantoms, was actually whom?
x: As Kalad, Vasher created the Phantoms during the Manywar.

q: What do Idrians call the body of water that Hallandren calls the Bright Sea?
x: Landlocked Idris downplays the sea that lets Hallandren's capital thrive as a port.

q: What is the name of the Hallandren religion that worships the Returned as gods?
x: The Iridescent Tones teach that only those who die exemplifying a great virtue are sent back as Returned.

q: What is the real name of the palace scribe known as Bluefingers?
x: He introduces himself to Siri by this name, adding that everyone calls him Bluefingers.

q: On which planet is Tress of the Emerald Sea set?
x: Lumar is a world of spore oceans fed by twelve moons, each hosting an aether.

q: What does Tress love to collect at the start of her story?
x: Tress treasures her cups for the stories each one seems to tell.

q: What kind of animal is Huck, Tress's talking companion?
x: Huck is a cursed talking rat who secretly spies for the Sorceress.

q: Who is Charlie, the young man Tress sets out to rescue?
x: The duke sent Charlie away on a voyage, and he ended up a prisoner of the Sorceress.

q: In which sea does the Sorceress hold her domain?
x: The Sorceress rules the Midnight Sea, where Tress must sail to rescue Charlie.

q: What happens when verdant spores come into contact with water?
x: Sailors use verdant vines as fuses or to entangle opponents.

q: Which spores release a burst of air when wet, making them ideal for firing cannons?
x: Zephyr spores fall on the Sapphire Sea and are used to propel cannonballs.

q: What is Fort's position aboard the Crow's Song?
x: Fort is deaf and communicates through a Nalthian board.

q: What does Dr. Ulaam, the Crow's Song's surgeon, ask for as payment?
x: Hoid claims Ulaam is the best doctor he has ever met, despite his odd fee.

q: Who does the crew elect as captain after Crow is removed?
x: Tress trades Crow to the dragon Xisis, and the grateful crew chooses her to lead.

q: What is the name of the new ship Tress and her crew buy at the end of the story?
x: Pardoned by the king, the crew sell the Crow's Song and buy the Two Cups, with Charlie aboard as valet, storyteller and musician.

q: In which of the twelve seas does the dragon Xisis make his home?
x: Xisis is a dragon originally from Yolen who, for a time, made his home in the Crimson Sea.

q: On which planet do Yumi and Painter live?
x: Komashi is home both to Yumi's yoki-hijo traditions and to Painter's city of Kilahito.

q: What does Yumi stack into delicate towers to summon spirits?
x: The spirits she draws grant blessings to the villagers of her land.

q: What does Painter hunt and capture with his brush and ink?
x: Nightmares seep out of the shroud, and painters trap them by painting them into harmless images.

q: What sacred title does Yumi hold among her people?
x: A yoki-hijo summons spirits for her people at great cost to her own freedom.

q: What is Painter's real name?
x: Nikaro usually goes by Painter, after his job as a nightmare painter.

q: What hangs permanently over the city of Kilahito?
x: Under the shroud Kilahito lives in constant darkness, lit by glowing hion lines.

q: In which two colors do Kilahito's hion lines glow?
x: Hion lines run through the city, providing both light and power.

q: Who is Yumi's strict guardian and attendant?
x: Liyun oversees Yumi's rigid daily rituals as a yoki-hijo.

q: Which of these characters is a fellow nightmare painter in Kilahito?
x: Painter meets Akane and Tojin on patrol at the city's western edge.

q: What is Masaka, who works as a nightmare painter, secretly?
x: Masaka, whose Sleepless name is Chinikdakordich, poses as an ordinary nightmare painter in Kilahito.

q: Which Shard Splintered herself on Komashi?
x: The remnants of Virtuosity's power shaped the strange Investiture of Komashi.

q: On which planet is The Sunlit Man set?
x: Canticle is a world scorched by a deadly, Invested sun.

q: In The Sunlit Man, why must the cities keep constantly moving?
x: Anyone caught in the planet's direct sunlight is burned to ash.

q: In The Sunlit Man, what is Rebeke riding when Nomad latches on to it and is dragged away with her?
x: Nomad hurls a chain onto Rebeke's departing hovercycle, and the sunlight starts to burn him as he is dragged away.

q: By what name was Nomad known when he lived on Roshar?
x: Sigzil was a member of Bridge Four before becoming the worldhopping Nomad.

q: Which group hunts Nomad from world to world?
x: Nomad keeps Skipping between planets to stay ahead of the Night Brigade.

q: Which tyrant rules the planet where The Sunlit Man is set?
x: The Cinder King commands the Charred, people enslaved by a corrupted sunheart driven into their chests.

q: What does Nomad's Torment make him unable to do?
x: The Torment stops him from causing harm even in self-defense.

q: What is the cause of Nomad's Torment?
x: Holding a Dawnshard leaves a lasting mark on whoever carried it.

q: What kind of being is Auxiliary, Nomad's talking companion?
x: Aux was nearly consumed by the Dawnshard Nomad once held and survives as a voice in Nomad's head.

q: On which planet is White Sand set?
x: Taldain is tidally locked, split into an eternal Dayside and Darkside.

q: What do Sand Masters expend from their own bodies to control sand?
x: Overusing sand mastery can dangerously dehydrate a Sand Master.

q: Who is Kenton's father, the powerful Lord Mastrell?
x: Praxton dies fighting the Kerztians, his final attack burying Kenton in sand.

q: What color does white sand turn after a Sand Master uses it?
x: Spent sand turns white again after about four hours in Dayside's sunlight.

q: In White Sand, what is distinctive about the planet's Darkside?
x: Darkside never faces the planet's bright main sun, which only lights Dayside.

q: What is the name of the order of Sand Masters that Kenton belongs to?
x: Kenton eventually becomes Lord Mastrell, leader of the Diem.

q: Which Shard Invests Taldain through its blazing larger star?
x: Taldain orbits a blue-white supergiant paired with a dim white dwarf.

q: On which planet is Sixth of the Dusk set?
x: First of the Sun is an ocean world dotted with deadly islands.

q: In Sixth of the Dusk, what are the talent-granting birds called?
x: Young Aviar must visit the island of Patji to gain their talents.

q: What is Dusk's profession?
x: Dusk traps Aviar on Patji, as was the tradition among his people.

q: Patji, the largest island of the Pantheon, is often called what?
x: Dusk and his people treat the deadly island of Patji with wary reverence, as a stern father.

q: What does Dusk's Aviar Sak show him?
x: Sak's corpse visions warn Dusk of danger ahead; her talent was unknown among Aviar before her.

q: What talent does Dusk's Aviar Kokerlii grant him?
x: On Patji, many predators hunt by sensing minds, so Kokerlii is vital.

q: On which planet do the Forests of Hell grow?
x: The Forests of Hell are haunted by shades, the spirits of the dead.

q: What does Silence Montane run in the Forests of Hell?
x: Silence runs the waystop with her daughter, William Ann.

q: In Shadows for Silence, which metal can destroy the shades?
x: Shades grow enraged if someone lights a fire, runs at night or sheds blood.

q: Under what secret identity does Silence hunt bounties?
x: Silence uses the bounties she collects to keep her waystop out of debt.

q: What became of Silence's grandmother after she was killed?
o: Her shade is bound in a shrine
She was buried in the Homeland
She was burned on a pyre
x: Silence trapped the shade of her strict grandmother in the waystop's shrine, and later unleashes it on the tax collector.

q: What job does Tress take on aboard the Crow's Song?
x: As the ship's sprouter, Tress handles the aether spores the crew uses to fight and to repair the ship.

q: What is Dr. Ulaam, the Crow's Song's surgeon, secretly?
x: Ulaam is a kandra from Scadrial working as the ship's surgeon.

q: Why did Ann originally sign on to the Crow's Song as its carpenter?
o: To avoid being drafted into the king's army
To pay off her family's debts
To search for a lost brother
x: Ann later volunteered to serve as the ship's assistant cannonmaster.

q: What do roseite spores do when they touch water?
x: Sprouters use roseite crystal to patch damaged hulls.

q: What lowly position does Hoid hold aboard the Crow's Song?
x: Hoid, the book's narrator, mops the Crow's Song's decks while under the Sorceress's curse.

q: What did the father machine turn most of Torio's people into?
x: Built to harvest Investiture from the hijo, the machine created the shroud and held the dead captive as Cognitive Shadows.

q: What had really been happening to Yumi before she was linked to Painter?
o: She was trapped in a simulation of her old life
She slept frozen inside a shrine
She was lost in Painter's dreams
She was a spirit bound inside a stone stack
x: After it killed her, the father machine hid Yumi in a simulation of her former life and patched over her memories to keep her complacent.

q: In Yumi and the Nightmare Painter, what did Hoid's companion open in Kilahito while he was frozen in time?
x: The Noodle Pupil was run with the cook Namakudo and later left to Yumi and Painter, who renamed it the Noodle Princess.

q: What are the hijo, the spirits that Yumi summons?
x: Hijo live underground and are drawn to thoughts, emotions and art.

q: Which of these women served as one of Yumi's attendants?
x: Hwanji, known for humming as she worked, had previously served Dwookim.

q: In The Sunlit Man, where do the sunhearts come from?
o: The Investiture of people who die there
x: Sunhearts form from people who perish in the planet's Invested sunlight, and they power the flying cities.

q: The people of The Sunlit Man's world descend from settlers who came from which planet?
x: They descend from Threnodite settlers.

q: What title does Elegy Salvage receive when the Greater Good chooses her to lead the city of Beacon?
x: Naming Elegy Beacon's Lodestar ended the practice of sacrificing the city's eldest members.

q: In The Sunlit Man, what are the flying cities, such as Beacon, built from?
x: The linked ships can be steered as one, kept aloft by sunhearts.

q: How is Elegy Salvage, who comes to lead the city of Beacon, related to Rebeke?
x: Rebeke and Elegy, along with their brother Divinity, belong to the Salvage family.

q: Besides sand mastery, what else uses up the power of the white sand?
x: Wet sand loses its power just like sand that has been mastered, until sunlight recharges it.

q: On the world of White Sand, what gives the Invested sand its white color?
o: A microorganism living on the grains
x: The organism draws on the light of the planet's larger sun, which also recharges spent sand.

q: How many Taisha sit on the Taishin, the ruling council of Lossand?
x: Each Taisha heads one of Lossand's Professions; the Lord Mastrell speaks for the Sand Masters.

q: What did Kenton do during his run of the Mastrell's Path that was thought impossible?
o: Killed the deep sandling that guarded it
Finished it without using sand mastery
Completed it in a single night
x: Kenton used his sword to kill the sandling at the heart of the Path, destroying the Path forever.

q: During which event do the Kerztian warrior-priests attack Kenton's order of Sand Masters?
x: Almost every Sand Master is killed, and Kenton believes he is the only survivor.

q: Which notorious highwayman does Silence hunt to pay off her debts?
x: Silence tracks Chesterton and his crew through the Forests of Hell.

q: Which tax collector from the forts threatens to claim Silence's waystop?
x: Theopolis warns Silence that the fort will take her waystop if she does not pay her taxes within a few days.

q: Who is the stableman at Silence's waystop?
x: In the first chapter Silence sends Dob on his break so she can water the horses herself.

q: Who is Red Young?
o: A bounty hunter from the forts
x: Red Young is one of the bounty hunters working out of the forts.

q: According to Arcanum Unbounded, how many continents does Threnody have?
x: The Evil overran the larger continent, and the survivors fled to the smaller one.

q: How do the Eelakin regard the islands of the Pantheon?
o: As the tombs of their ancestors
As the property of their king
x: Each trapper serves as a kind of priest of the island he traps.

q: What is the trading company's offworld machine meant to do on Patji?
o: Locate all of the island's Aviar
x: The machine was never meant to run: its offworld makers hoped its technology would hurry the Eelakin's progress so they could get around laws forbidding trade.

q: What actually grants the talented birds of Dusk's world their abilities?
o: A parasite they pick up on the islands
x: Sak, a mainland bird, only gained her talent after Dusk took her to Patji.

q: Who taught Dusk his profession?
x: After his uncle died on a trip to Patji, Dusk carried on alone on that island, as tradition demanded.

q: What is a deepwalker?
o: A huge sea predator that hunts by sensing minds
A diving ship of the Ones Above
x: A deepwalker wiped out Vathi's scouting team after it camped too close to the beach.

q: The Shards of the Cosmere are pieces of which ancient being?
x: Adonalsium was broken in the Shattering, and its power was divided among the Shards.

q: How many Shards was Adonalsium split into?
x: Each of the sixteen Shards embodies a single Intent, such as Honor, Ruin or Endowment.

q: The Almighty worshipped in the Vorin religion is actually which Shard?
x: Dalinar learns that the Almighty of Vorinism was Honor, and that he is dead.

q: Which Shard was responsible for the death of Honor?
x: Odium Splintered Honor before the events of The Way of Kings.

q: Which two Shards worked together to create humankind on Scadrial?
x: Ruin agreed in exchange for being allowed to destroy the world later, but Preservation betrayed and imprisoned him at great cost to himself.

q: Stormlight is the Investiture of which Shard?
x: Each Shard on Roshar has its own Light, and Stormlight is Honor's.

q: Who takes up Preservation's power to fight Ruin directly?
x: Vin and Ruin destroyed each other in their final clash.

q: Atium turns out to be the concentrated body of which Shard?
x: Ruin hid his body as atium, which was mined in the Pits of Hathsin.

q: On Roshar, what is the Cognitive Realm commonly called?
x: Jasnah and Shallan can glimpse and even slip into Shadesmar through Soulcasting.

q: The Physical and Cognitive Realms are two of the three Realms. What is the third?
x: The Spiritual Realm holds a thing's ideal form and is outside time and space.

q: What position does Hoid hold at King Elhokar's court?
x: As Wit he insults courtiers for a living, yet keeps his true purpose hidden.

q: Which worldhopper narrates Tress of the Emerald Sea?
x: Hoid tells the story of Tress, a young woman of the island world Lumar.

q: Which sentient sword from Nalthis ends up on Roshar?
x: Nightblood was Awakened on Nalthis with the Command to destroy evil.

q: Which Rosharan carries a sentient black sword from Nalthis in Oathbringer?
x: Szeth trains with the Skybreakers under Nale while bearing the sword.

q: Which secret society, through its agent Mraize, recruits Shallan?
x: In Words of Radiance, Mraize has Shallan, disguised as Veil, spy on Amaram's Sons of Honor.

q: Which was the first Cosmere novel to be published?
x: Elantris came out in 2005, set on the planet Sel.

q: What is the general Cosmere term for the power of the Shards in all its forms?
x: Stormlight, Breath and the Dor are all forms of Investiture on their respective worlds.

q: What makes up the 'ocean' of the Cognitive Realm on Roshar?
x: Each bead represents an object in the Physical Realm, and touching one reveals its nature.

q: The Stormfather is a remnant of which Shard?
x: After Honor's death, the Stormfather retained fragments of his power and memories.

q: Which worldhopper is the protagonist of The Sunlit Man?
x: Nomad keeps jumping between worlds to escape the Night Brigade.

q: Who took up both Ruin and Preservation to become Harmony?
x: Sazed, as Harmony, is worshipped by the people of Elendel in the second Mistborn era.

q: What is a Sliver?
o: Someone who once held a Shard and then let it go
Someone who currently holds a Shard's power
A spren bonded to a Herald
x: The Lord Ruler became a Sliver after briefly holding Preservation's power.

q: Which Shard is invested on Nalthis, the world of Warbreaker?
x: Endowment gives each person a single Breath and sends the Returned back to life.

q: Allomancy draws its power from which Shard?
x: The metals only act as a catalyst for Preservation's power, while Hemalurgy is tied to Ruin.

q: In The Lost Metal, the god Trell is revealed to be a guise of which Shard?
x: Harmony tells Wax that Autonomy acts through independent avatars, and Trell is one of them.

q: In The Lost Metal, which group led by Kelsier invites Marasi to join it?
x: Marasi works alongside offworld Ghostblood agents but turns down Kelsier's offer.

q: In Mistborn: Secret History, in which Realm does the protagonist linger after his death?
x: He refuses to pass into the Beyond and survives as a Cognitive Shadow.

q: Which worldhopper is the in-world author of the planetary essays in Arcanum Unbounded?
x: Khriss is a scholar of the Cosmere who studies its worlds and magic systems.

q: From which planet does the scholar Khriss come?
x: Khriss is a Darksider who travels to the Dayside of her world in White Sand.

q: Which two Shards were Splintered on Sel?
x: Their scattered power fuels the Dor, the source of Selish magic.

q: In Warbreaker, which god summons Hoid to the Court of Gods to tell stories?
x: Hoid recounts the history of the first Returned and the origin of the God Kings.

q: What musical instrument does Hoid leave with Kaladin?
x: Hoid plays it while telling the story of Derethil and the Wandersail, then tells Kaladin to keep it.

q: Which spren does Hoid find in Kholinar and later bond?
x: Hoid bonds the Cryptic Design and, through that bond, becomes a Lightweaver.

q: What is the name of Hoid's homeworld?
x: Yolen is where Adonalsium was Shattered, and is the setting of the planned Dragonsteel books.

q: Under what name does Vasher work as a swordmaster on Roshar?
x: Zahel trains Adolin, and his speech hints at the colors and Breath of Nalthis.

q: What is a place where a Shard's power pools and links the Realms, allowing travel between them?
x: Worldhoppers often use Perpendicularities to enter and leave the Cognitive Realm.

q: On Scadrial, which place is Preservation's Perpendicularity?
x: In Secret History, the novella's dead protagonist spends years beside the Well of Ascension.

q: What keeps Odium from leaving the Rosharan system?
x: Odium seeks a contest of champions as a way to escape this binding.

q: Who does Dalinar learn is the true identity of the old woman of the Valley?
x: Cultivation lives in the Valley alongside the Nightwatcher, a powerful spren.

q: How does Odium describe himself to Dalinar?
x: Odium insists he embodies every passion, not only hatred.

q: In Rhythm of War, with which weapon is Odium's Vessel killed?
x: Nightblood's hunger for Investiture let it destroy the Vessel of a Shard.

q: Who was the original Vessel of Odium?
x: Rayse held Odium for millennia, until he was killed at the end of Rhythm of War.

q: Who was the original Vessel of Ruin?
x: Holding Ruin for millennia gradually twisted Ati's mind toward its Intent.

q: Who is the Vessel of the Shard Autonomy?
x: Little is known about Bavadin, one of the most elusive Vessels in the Cosmere.

q: Which Shard did Odium mortally wound in the Threnodite system?
x: Ambition survived that clash but was later Splintered somewhere else.

q: Which worldhopper collects maps and artifacts for his employer and annotates the charts?
x: Nazh's handwritten notes appear on several of the maps and illustrations in the books.

q: The Elantrian Galladon is a member of which worldhopper society?
x: The Seventeenth Shard opposes meddling with the Shards and their worlds.

q: In which region of Roshar is Cultivation's Perpendicularity?
x: The Unkalaki tell of a sacred lake there that leads to the realm of the gods.

q: Who is the masked worldhopper who serves as Mraize's babsk?
x: Iyatil always keeps her face hidden behind a mask.

q: Which offworld Ghostblood agent uses soulstamps in The Lost Metal?
x: Soulstamps are a Selish art, the same one practised in The Emperor's Soul.

q: Which planet of the Rosharan system do Rosharans call Damnation?
x: Braize, the cold third planet of the system, is where Odium is bound and where the Heralds returned between Desolations.

q: From which planet of the Rosharan system did the humans of Roshar originally flee?
x: Humans destroyed much of Ashyn with their powers and came to Roshar as refugees.

q: What does a Feruchemist store in a duralumin metalmind?
x: Duralumin stores Connection, the Spiritual link to people and places; aluminum stores Identity, chromium Fortune and nicrosil Investiture.

q: What is the name of the Light that is the Investiture of Cultivation?
x: Lifelight is Cultivation's Light; combined with Stormlight it produces the Sibling's Towerlight.

q: From which planet does the worldhopper Nazh come?
x: Nazh is a native of Threnody, the world of the Forests of Hell.

q: Which city in the Cognitive Realm is a gathering place for worldhoppers from many planets?
x: Silverlight lies in the Cognitive Realm and serves as a meeting point for worldhoppers and scholars of the Realms.

q: According to Nikli in Dawnshard, the Dawnshards were eventually used to do what?
x: The Dawnshards are the four primal Commands that created all things, later turned against Adonalsium itself.

q: The Sleepless are hive minds made up of swarms of which small creatures?
x: A Sleepless spreads its mind across countless hordelings and can replace lost ones, letting it live for ages.

q: What was the name of the Vessel of Preservation?
x: Leras sacrificed much of his power to imprison Ruin, leaving himself near death.

q: The Sibling, the spren of Urithiru, is born of which two Shards?
x: The Sibling harmonizes the rhythms of Honor and Cultivation to produce Towerlight.

q: In Wind and Truth, Honor and Odium are joined into a single new Shard. What is it called?
x: Odium's Vessel absorbs Honor's power, and the combined Shard is called Retribution.

q: In Wind and Truth, who briefly takes up the power of Honor?
x: Dalinar ascends as Honor's Vessel and then renounces his oaths, releasing the Shard.

q: In what role does Hoid appear in Luthadel in The Final Empire?
x: Hoid sells information in Luthadel, and Kelsier is among those who consult him.

q: Hoid makes a brief appearance in The Alloy of Law, dressed as a beggar. At what event?
x: Hoid comes to the Yomen wedding reception to congratulate the couple, shortly before the Vanishers attack.

q: In Secret History, what does Hoid swallow in the chamber of the Well of Ascension?
x: No one can stop Hoid, who consumes the lerasium and leaves the chamber.

q: What kind of creature is Mraize's green pet bird?
x: Mraize's bird is an aviar, one of the talent-granting birds of First of the Sun.

q: Shallan overhears Mraize say that some pages must be brought to his master. Which name does he use?
x: Thaidakar leads Mraize's secret society, rivals of Restares and the Sons of Honor.

q: How does Hoid illustrate the history of Hallandren when he tells it at the Court of Gods?
o: By dropping colored sands and dusts
x: As Hoid speaks he lets sands, dusts and small objects fall, forming shapes on the floor.

q: Which story does Wit tell Kaladin when he finds him in a nightmare in Rhythm of War?
o: The Boy Who Stole the Wind
x: With his Cryptic creating illusions, Wit tells of a dog who wanted to become a dragon.

q: In Secret History, what nickname does the protagonist give Preservation?
x: He befriends the dying Preservation and calls him Fuzz.

q: In Secret History, what does Nazh give the protagonist before they part ways?
x: Nazh also points him toward the Ire, and he later uses the knife to smash their device and take up Preservation's power.

q: What do the Eelakin call the spacefaring visitors who sell them technology?
x: Dusk distrusts the Ones Above, even though he bought accurate sea maps from them.

q: What is the god metal associated with Odium called?
x: Presumably named after Odium's original Vessel, raysium has long been used by Odium's forces in their weapons.

q: What symbol must every member of the Ghostbloods have tattooed?
x: Jasnah later finds this symbol tattooed on the arm of a would-be assassin.

q: According to Arcanum Unbounded, how do people on Ashyn now gain magical powers?
x: After the cataclysm, Ashyn's magic became tied to illnesses.

q: Which worldhopper took Sigzil on as an apprentice Worldsinger?
x: Sigzil travelled with his master Hoid, training as a Worldsinger, before ending up in Bridge Four.

q: In Secret History, which crew member is freed from Ruin's control in Urteau and then visited in a dream?
x: In that dream, Spook is told to warn Vin about people pierced by metal.

q: In Dawnshard, what kind of being is Nikli, Rysn's attendant?
x: Nikli is a Sleepless swarm skilled at impersonating humans, set to guard the secrets of the hidden Aimian city.

q: What policy does the Shard of Khriss's homeworld impose on it?
o: Rule by a council of worldhoppers
x: The Shard keeps that world cut off while meddling elsewhere, so worldhoppers born there cannot return home.

q: In Tress of the Emerald Sea, which Selish magic does the narrator use to block the Sorceress's curse aimed at Tress?
x: The Sorceress was casting her curse with AonDor, and the narrator burst into her tower and blocked it with an Aon of his own.

q: In Elantris, what does Hoid help Sarene do?
x: Late in the novel, Hoid quietly helps Sarene get weapons into the city of Elantris.

q: Which of these beings belongs to Elantris rather than to Mistborn: The Final Empire?
x: Seons are the floating balls of light of Elantris; kandra, mistwraiths and Steel Inquisitors all appear in The Final Empire.

q: Which of these characters belongs to Mistborn: The Final Empire rather than to Elantris?
x: Clubs is the Smoker and carpenter of the thieving crew; Mareshe, Ahan and Lukel are characters from Elantris.

q: Which of these titles belongs to the Steel Ministry of The Final Empire rather than to the Derethi hierarchy of Elantris?
x: Obligators are the priests of the Steel Ministry; arteth, grador and odiv are positions in the Derethi chain of command.

q: Which of these characters belongs to Elantris rather than to Mistborn: The Final Empire?
x: Eondel is an Arelene noble and soldier who allies with Sarene; Dockson, Camon and Ham are characters from The Final Empire.

q: Which of these places appears in Mistborn: The Final Empire rather than in Elantris?
x: Fellise is the small town outside the imperial capital where the Renoux mansion stands; Ake, Ato and Toa are the outer cities around Elantris.
